anchor: Each entry is anchored to the LHMisme420/mcp-authscan commit that published or withdrew it in client/public/keys.json. Commit dates are informational: reports carry no signed signing time, so the verifier never compares a date with report content.
rule: Only keys with status active verify. A withdrawn or revoked key rejects every signature, because no signed time can show that a signature predates the withdrawal.
